journal-candle-size.alt: A My First Baobab candle beside a vase of tulips
journal-candle-size.body:
Start with where it will live

Think of the surface first: a bedside table, a bathroom counter, a console in the entry, a coffee table, a dining table. A small candle disappears on a large table; a large one crowds a narrow shelf. The glass, wood or concrete is on show all day, so choose a size that looks right unlit.

Baobab Collection, by height

Baobab names its candles by height in centimetres. MAX 08 Petite weighs 190 g and burns about 40 hours: a bedside, a powder room or a gift. MAX 10 Classique, 500 g and about 50 hours, suits a side table or a shelf. MAX 16 Signature, 1.1 kg and about 100 hours, holds its own on a coffee table or a console. MAX 24 Grande, 3 kg and about 340 hours, and MAX 35 Monument, 6.5 kg and about 600 hours, are centrepieces for a large living room or an entry.

Hypsoé and Apotheca

Hypsoé’s refillable candles sit in turned wood or concrete shells: the 11 cm shells hold a 200 g candle, about 40 hours, and the XL wooden shell holds 600 g, about 80 hours. When the candle is finished, the shell stays and a refill drops in. Apotheca’s amber apothecary jar holds 240 g of vegetable-based wax, about 50 hours, and is at home on a bathroom counter or a bookshelf.

Give the first light time

On every burn, let the whole surface melt, then burn no more than an hour longer. Keep the melted layer under 1 cm, trim the wick before lighting and stop when 1 cm of wax is left. A candle that melts evenly from the first evening burns evenly to the end. Never leave a lit candle unattended.

Still deciding?

Browse the candles by scent family in Shop by scent, or upload a photo of the spot and we suggest pieces that suit it.

journal-faux-fur-care.alt: An Evelyne Prélonge faux fur pompom key chain in chestnut on a leather bag
journal-faux-fur-care.body:
What it is made of

The maison, now Maison Prélonge, makes its faux fur in France from a blend of acrylic and polyester fibres, 100% animal-free. A throw is 85% acrylic and 15% polyester, lined in polyester.

The safest way: a professional cleaner

The maison recommends professional dry cleaning.

By hand

Soak it in lukewarm water with a mild soap, rinse gently, let it dry flat, then brush the fur softly.

By machine

Use a delicate cycle at 30 °C at most, with a mild detergent and a gentle spin of 400 to 600 turns, then dry it flat.

What to avoid

No fabric softener, no bleach, no iron and no steam.

Between seasons

Store your pieces away from light and away from any source of heat.

Choosing a throw

Our throws come in colours from Himalaya Pearl to Chestnut and Monaco. Not sure which suits your sofa? Upload a photo of it and we suggest pieces that work with it.

journal-valet-trays.alt: An Ethnicraft Chevron glass valet tray in gold and navy
journal-valet-trays.body:
1. In the entry

Set one on the console by the door for keys, a watch and whatever you empty from your pockets. It keeps the console tidy and gives the hallway a point of colour.

2. In the bathroom

Rings, earrings and a bottle of perfume look deliberate on a tray instead of scattered on the counter.

3. On the coffee table

Pair a tray with a small candle, such as a My First Baobab, and a box of matches. The tray frames them and catches any wax.

4. On the bedside

Glasses, a ring and a book light at the end of the day, gathered in one place you can find in the dark.

5. On the desk

Pens, a card holder and a phone. A tray turns a pile into an arrangement.

Caring for it

Dust it with a soft dry cloth and wipe a spill straight away with a damp cloth. The trays are made for indoor use.

Choosing yours

The valet trays come round, rectangular and as a pair of half-moons, in bronze, blush, slate, moss and more. Upload a photo of the spot and we suggest the one that suits it.
